hypothesis: An extended predeclared training budget may permit bounded raw-identity 256-float TTT to converge on freshly seeded task; to qualify it must beat both native original trained readout AND the strongest 256-float untrained factual memory, with explicit compute mismatch disclosure.

source.generator: Independent new P78-family worlds: eight per-world orthogonal 16D action keys with independent tanh 16D effects each repeated twice, plus eight FIT/VAL or 32 OOD unique random normalized distractor keys/effects. Uniform random interleaving; final simulated executed action query with 16 zero future consequence features. Historical updates see only executed action and observed effect, no roles or final target.
source.audit: FIT and VAL 4-position quartile max departure <=0.05 and index-only balanced accuracy<=0.55, deterministic cohort SHA, zero future query effect, no P65-P78 cohort reuse. No OOD generation until validation gate.

model.reference: Exact original HybridPilot(32,16,width16,heads2,SSM,attention,TTT,depth) from pinned model.py; frozen original stem/SSM/attention/TTT key/query/value/depth. Train only original ttt.proj and head; distinct seeds 790201,790203,790207.
model.state: 256-float per world raw fast-state W using raw normalized action and observed effect, eta=.5, no other raw memory, cold restores bitwise. Original SSM and attention also have memory costs beyond 256 floats.

training.pairing: same initial full core weights and exact training sample indices for three arms per seed
training.convergence: each raw_internal best checkpoint <=390 (never terminal 420), last two validation MSE <=1.05x best validation MSE. Otherwise STOP and preserve negative.
training.cost: record full training/feature extraction/inference time and trainable parameter/state counts; zero-parameter fixed baselines omit core SSM/attention and are NOT same whole-process FLOPs.

eligibility.pre_ood: All FIT/VAL audit, cold restore, exact original parameter, state and seed independence checks PASS. Both fixed 256-float baselines each <=0.75 zero VAL. Every raw_internal seed must <=0.95 strongest fixed direct 256-float baseline VAL, <=0.75 paired trained original native VAL, <=0.75 zero VAL AND meet 390-step and 5%-late-plateau convergence. All arms complete 420 updates. On any failure do not generate or score OOD.
eligibility.ood: Single new OOD dev cohort 128 worlds of 48 facts ONLY after all validation gates. Each raw_internal model <=0.90 strongest 256-float direct fixed baseline OOD, <=0.75 paired native model OOD, plus 2000 world bootstrap 95% lower relative gain >0 with seed 790401.
eligibility.negative: On newly generated independent negative worlds shuffle action/effect credit in past history; raw_internal wrong-credit MSE >=1.4x clean MSE per seed; bitwise cold restore and original source unchanged.
eligibility.status: DEV_PASS only if all frozen checks PASS; otherwise DEV_FAIL. Any DEV_PASS is engineering synthetic only, NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS or full-model learning or matched whole-process efficiency.
